what_this_is: The first run of the Milestone 5 Phase 1a availability probe, spec revision 1, exactly as the probe reported it. Availability metadata only: dates, counts, HTTP status codes and unit-free ratios; no price and no volume value.
how_it_was_read: The probe prints its report as canonical JSON, gzip with a fixed modification time, base64, in workflow-command notices ('m5-phase1a-probe part i of n') and one digest notice. The public check-run annotations API serves them without sign-in (the job log needs admin rights). They were fetched from /repos/Fahad9101/NRE/check-runs/113524435620/annotations and decoded with nre.m5_phase1a_probe.decode_annotations, which verifies the digest notice.
known_limits_of_this_run: The 16:00 minute bar holds the closing-auction cross, so the minute sample's 'after_hours' counts and shares include the closing cross and its ratios against the regular session are overstated; revision 2 of the spec separates the closing minute.
The sample does not say whether the daily bar's open, high, low and close are regular-session or all-hours prices; revision 2 adds that check as booleans.
Nothing here says anything about the 23 issuers' events or outcomes: no event day was sampled.
